name: gen_an_chebyshev_index_weighted_ordered_ring
statement: (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (a : ℕ → R) (ha : Monotone a) (n : ℕ) : ((n : R) - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ≤ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (i : R) * a i
closed: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (a : ℕ → R) (ha : Monotone a) (n : ℕ), ((n : R) - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ≤ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (i : R) * a i
informal: Generalizes Mathlib2.an2_chebyshev_index_weighted: ℝ → any linearly ordered commutative ring. Proof idea: induction on n, or Chebyshev sum inequality (MonovaryOn.sum_mul_sum_le_card_mul_sum) for the monotone pair (i, a i); no division is used.
type: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (a : ℕ → R), Monotone a → ∀ (n : ℕ), (↑n - 1) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ≤ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ↑i * a i
